title: Hydrogen–Palladium Moderation and Heavy-Metal Energy Concept

materials.proposedRole: proposed radioactive energy source / outer structure

claims.claim: A dense hydrogen-palladium core can absorb radiation from heavy-metal outer layers.
Nuclear decay can be converted into contained, emissionless usable energy by this arrangement.
Hydrogen adoption is constrained by round-trip efficiency and infrastructure requirements.
Corporate reluctance is caused by lack of profit in long-lasting self-sustaining technologies.

researchQuestions: What radiation species and energies are assumed?
What experimentally measured attenuation or moderation properties apply to the proposed geometry?
What physical mechanism converts decay energy to useful electrical or thermal output?
What waste heat, secondary radiation, activation and shielding remain?
Which hydrogen application is being compared: storage, transport fuel, industrial feedstock or power generation?
What primary sources support each economic or corporate-adoption claim?
